stem: Anvi must construct rectangle $ABCD$ with side $DC = 6\,\mathrm{cm}$ and diagonal $DB = 8\,\mathrm{cm}$.

options.text: Draw $DC = 6\,\mathrm{cm}$. At $C$ draw the line perpendicular to $DC$. With centre $D$ and radius $8\,\mathrm{cm}$, mark where that arc meets the perpendicular; that point is $B$.
Draw $DC = 6\,\mathrm{cm}$ and place $B$ anywhere $8\,\mathrm{cm}$ from $D$, with no perpendicular through $C$.
Locate $B$ by reading the printed numeral $8$ alone, with no arc centred at $D$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: B must lie on the perpendicular to $DC$ at $C$ and on the circle centred at $D$ with radius $8\,\mathrm{cm}$; their intersection fixes $B$.

teacher.key_rationale: A rectangle needs a right angle at C and diagonal length DB. Omitting the perpendicular drops a required condition. The bare numeral 8 is only a surface cue.
